Product Details: SONAX XTREME GLASS CLEAR Powerful streak-free glass cleaner with “pure-water” technology — removes grease, insect film and nicotine residues and reduces resoiling. SONAX XTREME Glass Clear is a high-performance, ready-to-use glass cleaner formulated for both interior and exterior vehicle glass (also useful around the house). Its “pure water” formulation improves wetting of glass surfaces so oily films, soot, fingerprints and insect deposits are loosened and removed without leaving streaks. The formula also contains resoiling-inhibiting agents that help water and grime run off quicker after rain. Available in 500 ml and 1 L formats. SONAX XTREME INTERIOR CLEANER Deep-penetrating interior cleaner that removes stubborn dirt and neutralises unpleasant odours for hygienic freshness. SONAX XTREME Interior Cleaner is a ready-to-use interior cleaner specifically developed for thorough cleaning of vehicle interiors and household soft surfaces. Its powerful formula penetrates and lifts stubborn dirt from upholstery, roof linings and other interior trim, while an integrated odour neutraliser actively reduces smoke, pet and food smells to leave a fresh scent. Designed for daily and periodic interior maintenance. SONAX FOAM / UPHOLSTERY CLEANER (Foam Upholstery Cleaner / Upholstery & Alcantara variants) Low-moisture foaming upholstery cleaner — lifts stubborn stains, restores colours, and can be vacuumed away for quick, low-moisture cleaning. SONAX Foam Upholstery Cleaner produces a controlled low-moisture foam that penetrates textiles, upholstery and carpets to lift dirt and stains while restoring colour without leaving dark water marks. The foam is designed to be worked in and then vacuumed up or wiped off, making it ideal for car interiors and household fabrics, and Sonax also offers specialized formulations for delicate Alcantara surfaces.
